steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Stop! Where are you taking him?

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Don't take him away. He's mine! I'm still hungry!
Carley makes a frantic attempt to stop the medics from carrying Greg away.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Enough! There is nothing left of his soul for you to consume.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Guards, restrain her, but don't get her hurt.

steps.speaker: FAC Guard
steps.content: Yes, Chief.
Carley has lost her mind and turned aggressive. The guards move in to restrain her while trying hard not to hurt her in the process.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're kind, Chief. Through and through. You even find it in yourself to be kind to a glutton.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Would you be so kind if it were me?
You seem to catch a flicker of uncertainty in her eyes, and then it's gone.
Your unhesitating reply seems to surprise Cabernet.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: There's a rumor about a soul-eating Sinner going around out there. Aren't you afraid?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's there to be afraid of? I have put the shackles on you, after all.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll treat you the way I treat any other Sinner. I'll try to understand your past, and I'll respect your choices, but...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This can't happen again. You can't go around manipulating innocent people again.
Having witnessed how Cabernet manipulated the couple today, you're even more unsure of your ability to stay patient with her.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Is it because of the rumor about the soul-eating Sinner?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's there to be afraid of? I have put the shackles on you, after all.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Manipulating innocent people for personal gain... That's what's scary.
Cabernet stares at the red light emanating from your palm and starts laughing.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I thought you'd be less composed when you got angry. Well, I like the way you are now anyway.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm serious.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They had a chance to build a bright future in Eastside. They had a chance to fulfill their dreams together.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You took that away from them. You forced them to stay by your side as your personal possessions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What they wanted might not have been much in your eyes, the princess of the Franc family. But for them, that's all they got.
You look to Carley, who is still struggling, her crazed face drained of all animation. You feel a sense of helplessness at the sight of her.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: No, it's not the right smell. It should be purer and more intense!

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Where is my food?!
The guards have surrounded her and are shouting warnings at her. She pays them no heed. She wants one thing, and one thing only...

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Souls! Delicious souls! Give me delicious souls!!
Cabernet, the culprit for all this mess, listens to your condemnation of what she did absentmindedly, like a bystander.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll do everything in my power to get Carley back to normal. As for you, Cabernet...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll apply to have your level of detention reassessed.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Oh, you don't want to fix me anymore, my good-hearted Chief?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Carley has lost her mind only because she was forced to consume Greg's soul. There's hope of getting her back to normal if we manage to calm her down, and help her remember her dream, the love of her life, things worthier of pursuit.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're different. You want to consume souls. That's your obsession, your only obsession.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even this show you put on today, you did it only to make my soul more palatable to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "It takes great patience to make great food. Keep your 'ingredients' close at hand, nurture them..."

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Hahaha, you're more serious now as the Chief of the MBCC than when you were at the dinner party.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I like it when you're serious, though, and I also like this face-to-face format of questioning.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "...Occasionally providing some stimulants to trigger their change..."

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Could you please let her go? You can keep me in her stead.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: We are free.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Souls! Delicious souls! Give me delicious souls!!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "Then observe and wait for the day they flourish."

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Shackles are indeed powerful... my dear Chief...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But a Sinner's power comes from their heart...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: My heart... is filled with the desire for delicious food and "souls."

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I hope that the growth of your power can catch up with...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The expansion of my desires.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As a Franc, you can have whatever you want. But you want nothing but "gourmet foods."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I can help Carley, but I can't help you, at least not in the same way. Thank you for showing me your "main course." Now, let's end this "banquet."
Cabernet doesn't say anything in response. She only looks at you; her expression is hard to read, but seems to carry a hint of joy. This time, she's looking at your eyes, not your neck.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I want nothing but "gourmet foods"...

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Yes!
Cabernet is about to say something else when Carley lets out a shriek of delight. Carley, standing only a few steps away, is staring at you; she then bursts out laughing.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Pure, sincere, passionate... Isn't this the noblest soul there is? It's right in front of me!

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: I found it! The ultimate delicacy!
Light Bouncing Off Blade, Black Screen
Heartbeat Sound Effect
Heartbeat Sound Effect
Eyes Opening, Commotion, Cabernet's Portrait
Wh-what happened?

steps.speaker: FAC Guard
steps.content: When did she get hold of the knife?!

steps.speaker: FAC Guard
steps.content: We didn't notice. She got freakishly strong all of a sudden and broke free.

steps.speaker: FAC Guard
steps.content: Thank God Chief is unharmed. Restrain her. Quick! And where are the medics? We've got a wounded Sinner here!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Yes?

Looking at Cabernet, you remember the poolside where you met her properly for the first time. Her eyes on you are as calm as they were back then, except that there's now a faint metallic smell in the air.
Are you hurt?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I guess. I've got a hole in my back. Kind of painful, to tell the truth.

options: You don't look like the kind...

choices.text: You don't look like the kind...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What? The kind of person who would throw herself in front of you to save you?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What if I told you I did it because I wanted to protect the most impeccable soul I've ever seen?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You don't know?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I did it because I wanted to protect the most impeccable soul I've ever seen.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Miss Franc, this dish was prepared by the most sought-after head chef of the most sought-after 3-star restaurant in all of Eastside.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Under the theme of "Impeccable Souls," as you requested.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: What's the matter? Is it not to your taste?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What I'm looking for is a dish that draws me in even before I taste it.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: A dish that stirs something deep inside of me the moment I lay eyes on it. This is not it.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: We've tried every renowned chef in DisCity. None of them was up to your standards. How about I look further afield and get some chefs from Outland?

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: I'm sure they'll open the WhiteSands route for us if you make the request.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: How are my "ingredients"?

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Still unconscious. Your last meal has taken a great toll on them.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Is that so?

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Sorry, Miss Franc, for disappointing you. So... We've just received a batch of new clothes for this season. Would you like to see them?

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: And the construction of the new horse riding arena is complete. You can go down there to kill time...

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Or...
The butler lifts his eyes and flicks a discreet glance at Cabernet. He catches a glimpse of her eyes, which seem devoid of feeling.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Whatever you want, I can arrange for you... It doesn't matter if it's allowed or not. Anything other than gourmet foods that taste like souls, that is.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Anything other than gourmet foods that taste like souls...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Is there any?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You have helped me find the answer, I believe.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Yes, I am a bottomless pit. But there's nothing wrong with that, is there?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I seek out ingredients, nurture them, and turn them into foods. I pursue them the way others pursue dreams and love. And I won't stop pursuing them!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Anger, sadness, heartache, anxiety, confusion...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What emotions did Carley and Greg evoke in you? What emotions did I evoke?
She rests her head against your shoulder, feeble from the stab wound. You put your hand on her back to comfort her.
You feel something warm and sticky on the back of her exquisite gown. That brings home the fact that she's badly injured.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Condemn me, fear me, or even resent me... However you feel about me, there's no denying...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: ...that you understand me.
You feel her warm breath on your neck, but the feeling of dread that you associate with your soul being extracted doesn't come.
You hear her swallow as her cold fingers brush against an unruly strand of hair behind your ear. You know she's trying hard to restrain herself from doing the thing she wants to do so much.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Chief, I don't need you to save me, the way you do with the others. Nothing brings me more joy than being with my perfect "ingredient" forever.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: If you want to help me, then stoke up my insatiable thirst for deciduous souls...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: See through my hunger and greed, like you did today.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: And then stop me by drawing strength from your sense of justice and anger.

So far Cabernet has kept her promise.
Since joining the MBCC, she has never fed on souls.
Nor has she orchestrated any shenanigan that puts innocent people in harm's way.
But she's never given up the idea of nurturing her "ingredient."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will. I promise you that.
